title: Yeah Nah Pasaran #304 w Jason Wilson on the 2026 US mid-terms: The End of MAGA? : November 5, 2026
content:
This week on Yeah Nah Pasaran! we talk to Jason Wilson [Bluesky]. Jason is a freelance journalist who has been a regular guest on YNP! since 2020. Last time we spoke to Jason was in August on US imperial decline. On this occasion, we canvassed his views on the fact that the Democrats have won the Senate and the House in the US midterm elections, taking control of Congress for the rest of Trump’s presidency.

title: Yeah Nah Pasaran #303 w Royce Kurmelovs on Pauline Hanson’s One Nation Party : October 29, 2026
content:
This week on Yeah Nah Pasaran! we talk to Royce Kurmelovs [Bluesky]. Royce is a freelance journalist and author, whose latest title is SLICK: Australia’s toxic relationship with Big Oil. He recently analysed the obscure financial arrangements behind One Nation for Deepcut News in The corporate forces bankrolling One Nation’s ‘anti-establishment’ surge (October 20, 2026). We spoke to Royce about Hanson, her party, and its recent apparent surge in popularity.
